draftMessage: Your payment is ready. Click below to lock in the real-time ZEC exchange rate and begin your 15-minute checkout window.
rateExplanation: The ZEC amount will be calculated at the exact moment you click. You will have 15 minutes to complete the payment.
orSendManually: or send manually using the details below
sendRemaining: Send the remaining {remaining} ZEC to complete your payment
overpaidMessage: An overpayment of {amount} ZEC was detected. Contact the merchant for a refund of the excess.
paymentDetectedDesc: A payment has been detected and is waiting for network confirmation. This page will update automatically once confirmed.
expiredRetry: Your checkout window expired. Click below to get a fresh ZEC exchange rate and restart the 15-minute payment window.
partialExpired: A partial payment of {amount} ZEC was received. Enter your refund address below to request a refund from the merchant.
expiredMessage: This invoice has expired. Please create a new order.
refundPrivacyHint: Providing a refund address reveals it to the merchant, reducing your privacy.
refundEventHint: If the event is cancelled, this address will be used for your refund.
mempoolHint: After sending, there may be a short delay before your payment appears here. If your wallet confirms the transaction, it will be detected automatically.
ticketGeneratingHint: Waiting for network confirmation. Please do not close this page.
lumaRegisteringHint: Your payment is confirmed. Registering you on Luma...
lumaEmailNote: Luma will email your ticket and calendar invite.
lumaRegistrationFailed: Payment confirmed. Luma registration is being processed.
lumaRegistrationFailedHint: Contact the event organizer if your registration doesn't appear.
donationReceipt: Want a tax receipt? Contact {org} at {email} with reference code {memo}.
donationReceiptNoEmail: Want a tax receipt? Contact {org} with reference code {memo}.
donationShareDefault: I just donated with Zcash — private, non-custodial, direct.
donationConfirming: Your donation has been detected on the network and is waiting for block confirmation. This usually takes a few minutes.

crosschain.title: Complete your payment
crosschain.restoreError: We could not restore your payment. Reload before sending funds.
crosschain.alreadyStarted: Payment already started or quote expired. Follow the current payment status.
crosschain.connectFirst: Connect a wallet for this network first.
crosschain.refundMismatch: Connect the wallet matching the saved refund address, or send manually.
crosschain.rejected: Payment cancelled in your wallet. No new transaction was submitted.
crosschain.sendUncertain: Check your wallet before doing anything else. The payment may have been sent; do not send it again.
crosschain.copyError: Could not copy. Select and copy the address manually.
crosschain.manualAvailable: No compatible browser wallet detected. You can pay with a QR code or copied address.
crosschain.addressPlaceholder: Your wallet address on this network
crosschain.refundHint: Use a wallet you control on the selected network, not an exchange deposit address. Unused input or swap refunds go here.
crosschain.fees: Fees included. Wallet network fees are extra.
crosschain.estimate: Estimated conversion: {minutes} min, plus payment confirmation. Timing can vary.
crosschain.quoteMayChange: The final deposit amount is shown before you send.
crosschain.stale: Status is temporarily unavailable. Keep this page; do not send again.
crosschain.confirming: The provider reports delivery. Waiting for CipherPay to detect the full ZEC payment.
crosschain.recovery: Do not start another swap. Contact the merchant with reference {reference}.
crosschain.refundedHint: The provider reports a refund to your saved refund address. The order remains unpaid. Contact the merchant for a new checkout.
crosschain.underpaid: The full ZEC invoice amount has not arrived. Your order remains unpaid while we track this payment.
crosschain.manual: Pay using QR or copy address
crosschain.networkOnly: Send only {symbol} on {network}. The QR contains the address only; copy the exact amount below.
crosschain.incompleteHint: Do not resend the full amount. Wait for the provider’s refund or contact the merchant for help.
crosschain.expiredHint: Do not send to these instructions now. We continue tracking any payment already sent.
crosschain.privacy: The provider can link your source payment and destination. The merchant receives shielded ZEC.
crosschain.automaticAmount: Your wallet fills in the exact amount. Just review and confirm.
crosschain.manualAmountHint: Copy and paste this amount. The rounded estimate is not a payment instruction.
crosschain.networkMatch: Choose the network your funds are on.
crosschain.howToPay: How would you like to pay?
crosschain.walletChoiceHint: Review and confirm in your wallet
crosschain.manualChoiceHint: Scan a QR or copy the address
crosschain.manualSteps: Enter a refund address, review the quote, then get a QR code and payment address. No wallet connection needed.

crosschain.amountUnavailable: Other crypto payments aren’t available for this amount. You can pay with ZEC.
crosschain.availabilityUnknown: Couldn’t check availability. You can still pay with ZEC, or try again.
crosschain.someRoutesUnknown: Some networks couldn’t be checked. Available routes are ready to use.
crosschain.availabilityReady: Available routes checked. Your final quote is confirmed before payment.
crosschain.setupNotSent: Setup stopped before a wallet transaction was requested. No payment instructions were issued.

crosschain.waitingHint: Send using the instructions below. We’ll follow the conversion automatically.
crosschain.resumeHint: This may take a few minutes. Updates automatically — don’t send again.
crosschain.checkingAvailabilityHint: Finding tokens and networks that support this amount.
crosschain.fullLinkRequired: Open the full payment link provided by the merchant to use cross-chain payments.
